description: Factor prevalence among all crashes (CRSS) vs among fatal crashes (CRSS and FARS), crude fatal rate and over-representation ratio; for driver-age flags the FARS share is among crashes with known driver age (CRSS uses NHTSA's imputed age) and the unknown level has no ratio
method: Design-based (CRSS: Taylor linearisation, 25 strata/67 PSUs) or census counts (FARS)
